content: Wimaamala
Tau Paulo ma tulata Sositene. Yaubada i winaganiu tau Keliso Yesu a tu wituwetuwega po ipa a nugotuhu a dewahi.

Taumi Yaubada a bolu o memae Kolinito meyageina uyahina, omi leta geka a giluma neiyahi. Taumi Yesu Keliso amaka i otugemi po i wiwoiyawemi po a bolu i inaganihi u hinehi o lui mai. Taumi po tauyai po gasi tauhi tupo wohepali uyahihi miteta ta laupali gogona Yesu Keliso gowanei, tauna ataputa ata Guyau.
Yaubada amata ma ata Guyau Yesu Keliso hai lunugotootogo, po hai nugodumola hina melabenimi.
Houga magomagouna Yaubada a maamali babana tauna a lunugotootogo i welemi Yesu Keliso uyahinei.
Yaka ginouli dewadewahi e welemi po o iwasawasa naka omi wibaabani po omi hanapu uyahina.
Ma a imaamala matababana Keliso o kawamoineya po noyana o witumaganeya,
po Yaubada anani’mbenena dewadewahi atapuhi uyahimi he memae, ma houga geka o iotonana ata Guyau Yesu Keliso a gunawilana meme binei.
Tauna e woomomohita ipa ata Guyau Yesu Keliso a iyeta uyahina ega ina igouta.
Yaubada emoemotana po ta witumaganeya naka i wiutaneta ipa Natuna Yesu Keliso ata Guyau mitehi ta witulana gogona.
Tu witumagana ega hina ikahakaha
Walewalehiu, geka u wihaahalana uyahimi, ata Guyau Yesu Keliso gowanei ipa ega ona imemepuputana ma ona winaowelewelena po nugonugomi emosi ma ona tanitaniwaga gogona.
Babana Kiloi a manago gehouhi amaka hi paliweleu omi wikahakaha binei.
U baha anona gegeka, gehoumi o pa, ‘Tauyai Paulo a bolu,’ ma gehoumi o pa, ‘Tauyai Apolo a bolu,’ ma gehoumi o pa, ‘Tauyai Pita a bolu,’ ma gehoumi o pa, ‘Tauyai Keliso a bolu.’
Iyowai, Keliso i maga, bo? Eega. Tau Paulo hoi ani take a hilage bimiyei, bo? Eega. Ma gowaugei hi wibapatisomi, bo? Eega.
Yaubada a maamali matababana ega bolu baneina ata wibapatisomi, naka Kilisipa ma Gaiyasi tunawahi.
Uyahinei ega ona ibaabani ona pa, ‘Tauyai Paulo a bolu, babana Paulo i wibapatisoiyai.’
(Oo baha dumana gasi Setepano managona a wibapatisohi, nugote naka amaka magouhina.)
U bagibagi Keliso i weleweleu naka tuwega dewadewana luguguyana, ma ega wibapatiso. Ma u luguguya ega ipa baha hanahanapugei meka po apo Keliso a hilage hoi ani take maninina a wiapapoeya.
Keliso a hilage hoi ani take
Keliso a hilage hoi ani take, tauhi alugohi hilahilagehi, tuwega geka hi kawaikoyakoyameya, ma tauta ta lauyagohana naka Yaubada a manini tuwegana e memae uyahita.
Geka bahana binei ma Yaubada a Buka i bahebaheya i pa,

content.text: ‘Lawa tauhi launugoholaholahi hai nugotuhu a wiapapoenihi
ma tauhi tu hanahanapu hai hanapu a liyababahi.’

content: Uyahinei tauhi tu hanahanapu iyowai? Po tauhi tu wiatatiyana iyowai? Po tauhi tu baha hanahanapu geka hougana hoi hipuli he memae iyowai? Hai hanapuhi Yaubada amaka i liyababahi, bo?

Matababana hipuli nugotuhunei apega Yaubada ta hanapugeya. Tamogi Yaubada a nugotuhu tuwega dewadewana wiatatiyanana uyahinei tu witumagana tauta i luyawahita. Tuwega geka tu mehipuli hi kawaiapapoeya.
Mi Yudeya nugonugohi ipa manini hina galeya, ma mi Giliki hai luhogala ipa hina hanapu duma,
ma tauta tuwega ta lauguguyeya Keliso a hilage hoi ani take binei, naka mi Yudeya he ihinigigiyeya ma tauhi ega mi Yudeya he kawakawaibuubuuweni.

Tamogi tauta Yaubada tu witumaganena bolu i inaganita, mi Yudeya i bolu, po taumi ega mi Yudeya omi bolu, ataputa uyahitiyei tuwegana naka Yaubada a hanapu po a manini Yesu Keliso uyahinei e weleweleta.
Babana Yaubada a bagibagi yabayababa tauta lawa ata hanapu i gelagonihi ma Yaubada a bagibagi tapitapiyana tauta lawa ata kadidili baneihi i kadidila lagonihi.
Walewalehiu, ona nugotuhuya naka tauta Yaubada i inaganita ta maga duma tauta ega hipuli a hanapugei bo a kadidiligei bo a wibadagei.
Tamogi buubuwata i winaganita po tu hanahanapu ta witepahinihinimayahi, ma hoi hipuli ta itapitapiya Yaubada i winaganita po tu kadidili ta witepahubahi.
Yaka lawa awai hi gagalena hopuhopuneya po hi ihinigigiyeya ipa ega anona naka Yaubada i winaganihi ma i wobuiya po lawa awai u nugonugohi i gegeduma naka i liyababahi.
Uyahinei ega emoemotana po lawa gehouna Yaubada u matana ina baha gegae.
Yaubada tauna a bagibagigei Yesu Keliso mitehi ta wiemota po Yaubada hanapuna Yesu i houna damaneya uyahita. Yaka ta hanapugeya tauna amaka i houna idumaluta po i wiwoiyaweta po i wimihena haleta.
Uyahinei Yaubada a Buka i bahebaheya i pa, ‘Iyai apo ina baha gegae yaka ata Guyau tunawana ina hunehuneya.’
